notes:
- **Add-ons start out doing the most they can on their own.** When you add one that can work more
  than one way, it asks once which way you want, with the one that does the most for you marked
  Recommended and already picked. If that way needs something you have not given it yet, like your
  email or another add-on, it works the next best way in the meantime and tells you the one thing
  to press.
- **Spending Record can get your card statements from your bank's website on its own**, through
  Statement Collector. It can also read your statement emails or your purchase alerts, with each
  bank's steps on its card, or take statements you send it. You no longer type in your accounts.
- **Bills & Subscriptions finds your bills itself**, in your receipts and renewal emails or in
  Spending Record's purchases, and shows what repeats on one card for you to check.
- **Ask your agent to change how it is set up**, like "switch Spending Record to purchase alerts" or
  "stop using emojis". It says in one line what changed, and saying undo puts it back. Only you can
  ask, and a switch on its Setup tab turns this off.
- **Four add-ons offer to do the first step:** an empty to-do list offers to look through your recent
  email for things you were asked to do, Calendar Manager sets your time zone when you tell it,
  Email Manager offers a signature copied from your sent emails, and the journal says how many days
  a look back is drawn from.
- **A new agent has its catches on:** someone new waiting an hour, replies you owe, and an email
  asking to change where a payment goes. Stop is under the first card one of them changes.
- **The morning list takes the place of Today's Calendar too.** Saying yes to it pauses the Morning
  Task Checklist and Today's Calendar, since the list has both on it, and Keep all three brings them
  back. The Routines tab offers the same pause.
- **The Morning Task Checklist no longer uses your AI.**
- **A job's extras each sit under their own switch** on its card, so birthdays or stocks show up in
  one place.
- **Package Tracker's Shop sign-in shows as a QR code** too, so you can approve it on your phone.
- **Ask your agent why your texts are not coming** and it checks this Mac: whether Archie can read
  Messages, when it last read, and why reading has been failing.
- **Archie checks the tool that reads your texts each time it starts**, and downloads its own copy
  when that is missing or out of date. An old copy installed some other way is no longer used.
- Fixed: Text Replies stopped drafting on an agent moved to another Mac.
